title: A host dsh can keep the site agent's notes, and a store it cannot create is said on the log
steps: S1: run the host dsh init with a sites root.
S2: capture a note where the store's folder cannot be created (EACCES).
expect: S1: the init makes .site-notes under the sites root, mode 0700, owned by www-data (33:33), which dsh runs as.
S2: the job's warn log names the stage, the site and the code; nothing is thrown.
evidence: Issue #210: on a host dsh the notes store under the root-owned sites root could not be created, and every capture failed without a word

tests: the site agent’s notes store is made under the sites root, dsh’s own (www-data), so wishes are kept (#210)
capture: a store the host process cannot create is said on the log by its code, never silently (#210)
